title: Hollywood Wax Museum Entertainment Center All-Access Pass Myrtle Beach
blurb:
Get the most out of Myrtle Beach with this All-Access Pass to 3 Attractions, including The Hollywood Wax Museum Myrtle Beach, Hannah's Maze of Mirrors, and Outbreak - Dread The Undead.

Hollywood Wax Museum - Here’s the place to be an A-List pal, posing with famous folks, as your adoring fans snap away. Props help inspire photo ops with some of your favorite celebrities, and even dancing on center stage with pop stars!

Hannah's Maze of Mirrors - Find out if you’re “The Chosen One” on a fairytale quest that’s full of fun and surprises. Deep in the Castle of Savannah, you’ll be immersed in a mirrored world on the search for Princess Hannah

Outbreak - Dread The Undead
This fun scare will have your heart pounding as you walk through the facility’s testing areas, morgue, and rotting basement to contain the zombies and prevent a worldwide outbreak.

And don’t miss the most photographed point of interest in Myrtle Beach, the Great Ape towering over Highway 17 Bypass.
